sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.

sentences.en: Today I will be interviewing my sister again with some new beginner English questions all in a slow comprehensible way for you to learn English faster. So,.

sentences.en: What do you write? I write product descriptions. Mhm. What's something you do every day? Something?
sentences.tc: 你寫什麼？我寫產品描述。嗯。你每天都做些什麼？某物？

sentences.en: I do every day is probably drinking a banana smoothie. Mhm. Every morning, afternoon, or night. Usually for breakfast.
sentences.tc: 我可能每天都會喝香蕉冰沙。嗯。每天早上、下午或晚上。通常當早餐。

sentences.en: What are some hobbies that you like to do from time to time?

sentences.en: I like going to the gym.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡去健身房。
